question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e." At".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank number 1** needs the correct usage of a preposition.
 
• Let's have a look at the **usage of different prepositions**:
 
• **"At": **We use **at** to refer to time or place. We also use it to refer to activities. **“At” **is generally used about specific times on the clock or points of time in the day.
 
 
• *** Example:*** * I was up **at 7:00 **am this morning. *
 
 
 
• *​ ***So, **in the above blank preposition of time will be used to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Out of the given options, **Option 3** is the correct answer.

The complete passage is- *Nawab Mir Osman Ali Khan was the last ruler of Hyderabad, the largest princely state in British India. He ascended the throne (1) at the age of 25 and ruled Hyderabad for 37 years. He (2) was featured on the cover of Time magazine as the (3) richest person at the time. He was the 5th richest man in (4) the** history of mankind and the richest Indian who ever lived. He was a (5)benevolent ruler who encouraged education, science and development.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's learn the usage of other options __
 
• With: Preposition of connection.** Accompanied by**(another person or thing).
 
 
• *** Example***:* In the end, Rama decided to leave* ***with ****Sumit. *
 
 
 
• *​ *Of: Preposition of means containing or consisting of something.
 
 
• ***Example:*** *She was running short **of** time. *
 
 
 
• *​ *To: We can use 'to' to indicate a destination or direction.
 
 
• ***Example: **Does he want to come** to **the mall with us?*
 
 

46:T
